lede: The week's heaviest lift lands Tuesday, September 22, when Telluride Town Council takes up a deed-restriction conversion that would remove the price cap on two affordable units at 215 East Colorado — a structural change to the housing stock that deserves a close look. The Housing Authority meets the same day with overlapping business, and the School Board moves from work session to formal votes on policy second readings and resolutions tied to state ballot measures. Wednesday, the County Commissioners continue a public hearing on adopting new International Building Codes that will set construction standards across the region.

notable.stake: First vote on Norwood's Land Use Code rewrite — rare and far-reaching.
Board votes on state ballot measure resolutions and two policy second readings.
Resolution would convert two affordable ownership units, removing their price caps.
Council votes on deed-restriction change stripping price cap from two housing units.
Commission decides on leak forgiveness requests and a new leak-check fee.
Continued public hearing on new building codes shaping future construction countywide.
